10.text: Figure 5: Share of M2M Campaign Impacts in Overall NASA Impacts for Top Ten States and U.S. (employment, based on FY 2023). The displayed chart contains one stacked bar for each of ten states. Red represents M2M and blue represents Non-M2M. M2M shares are: Washington: 76%; Utah: 67%; Colorado: 64%; Alabama: 64%; Florida: 37%; Texas: 36%; California: 24%; Virginia: 17%; Ohio: 16%; Maryland: 4%. Washington has the highest displayed M2M share and Maryland has the lowest. M2M exceeds 50% in four of the ten displayed states: Washington, Utah, Colorado, and Alabama.
